page: Amazon Web Services g7.2xlarge is a graphics-intensive GPU-accelerated server instance built on the AWS Nitro System hypervisor. The instance features 8 dedicated x86_64 physical CPU cores manufactured by Intel, operating at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz with a single thread per core, alongside 32 GB of system memory. Hardware acceleration is provided by an integrated NVIDIA Blackwell RTX PRO 4500 GPU equipped with 32 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage consists of a 440 GB NVMe SSD, complemented by a 40 Gbps baseline network bandwidth allocation.

The inclusion of a discrete GPU with 32 GB of VRAM alongside 8 dedicated Intel CPU cores establishes a balanced compute foundation for graphics-heavy and accelerated workloads. While specific synthetic CPU, memory, and LLM inference benchmarks are not available, the instance offers dense resource partitioning by pairing equal physical CPU core counts with vCPUs. The local 440 GB NVMe SSD provides low-latency ephemeral disk storage, reducing host-level I/O bottlenecks during direct data transfers. The 40 Gbps network interface supports moderate bandwidth requirements for distributed setups.

From a resource density and cost efficiency perspective, bundling 32 GB of system RAM with an equivalent 32 GB of GPU VRAM optimizes resource allocation without overprovisioning system memory relative to accelerator memory. A tradeoff for this instance type includes the reliance on ephemeral local storage, requiring external persistent volumes for durable storage architectures. The g7.2xlarge instance is suited for graphics rendering, 3D visualization, video processing, computer-aided engineering, and light-to-moderate machine learning inference tasks.
description: Amazon Web Services g7.2xlarge is a graphics-intensive, GPU-accelerated virtual server hosted on the AWS Nitro System. Utilizing an x86_64 architecture, the instance is powered by 8 dedicated physical Intel CPU cores operating at 3.9 GHz and features 32 GB of system memory. For accelerated processing, it incorporates a single NVIDIA Blackwell RTX PRO 4500 GPU equipped with 32 GB of VRAM. High-speed local disk storage is supplied via a 440 GB NVMe SSD, supported by a baseline network throughput of 40 Gbps. Matching 32 GB of system memory with 32 GB of GPU VRAM provides an efficient resource footprint for graphics and compute pipelines without excessive memory overprovisioning. The local NVMe drive delivers low-latency scratch space for active file operations. The g7.2xlarge instance is suited for workloads such as 3D graphics rendering, computer-aided design, video processing pipelines, interactive visualization, and targeted machine learning inference jobs.
